payload.summary: Inside-out evidence: standup reuses resolveSince for whole-hour/day windows or ISO UTC and refuses an omitted window; progress accepts optional ISO --since plus positive --limit, streams a ring buffer of the newest N, then renders oldest-to-newest/newest-last. plan --reader and actor identity use exact kind:id[:session]; no existing kind-only actor filter exists. Top-level registry verbs brief, progress, recall, standup, and plan are cross-store reads, while roadmap node/map/ticket operations stay nested. Map decisions order by resolution event in canonical ts-seq-id order. Zoom hints are executable arrow commands such as roadmap ticket show, roadmap map show, and progress --item; recall prints structured source event ids. Brief caps orientation output and explicitly points to fuller commands.
